description: G14 stage 2: an EN57-2000 unit without a driver runs at 20 km/h into a standing one on td.scn, with physics.derailment new. Too fast for the automatic couplers to catch: past the buffers the cab ends crush, a few decimetres, too little for either unit to climb onto the other, so both stay on the rails; the run ends on the 60 s test timeout.

checks.pattern: Bad driving: autotest_\S+ and autotest_\S+ collided at \d+ km/h, the \w+ end of autotest_\S+ crushed
